name_note: GTDB splits the classical genus Ruminococcus into several genera; Ruminococcus_C is the split that contains Ruminococcus callidus, and its genomes carry the NCBI genus name Ruminococcus.

sentences.text: A study of human gut Ruminococcus species reported that Ruminococcus callidus and related human symbionts encode elaborate cellulosomes that are invisible to sequence-based annotation.
That study describes cellulosomes as large, surface-displayed enzyme complexes that enable anaerobic bacteria to degrade recalcitrant plant polysaccharides.
Ruminococcus callidus occurs among human faecal bacteria, and a species-specific 16S rRNA probe was designed to detect members of the species.
In a comparison of lean and obese women, lean Ghanaians had a significantly greater proportion of Ruminococcus callidus.
